fact: Mayo Clinic is a private nonprofit academic medical center; 501(c)(3) ruling year 1947
Mission: 'The needs of the patient come first'
Three destination campuses: Rochester, Minnesota (flagship); Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona; Jacksonville, Florida
Mayo Clinic Health System is an affiliated community hospital network in Minnesota, Wisconsin, and Iowa
William Worrall Mayo, M.D. began seeing patients in Rochester, Minnesota in 1864; his sons joined in the 1880s
Nearly 85,000 employees worldwide (2025); added approximately 12,400 new employees in 2025
Operating revenue 2025: $21.5 billion (8.7% increase over 2024)
Operating revenue 2024: $19.79 billion; operating income $1.3 billion (6.5% operating margin)
Net income 2025: $1.5 billion
Research and education investment 2024: $1.343 billion total; external $782.3M, internal $539.5M
NIH funding FY2024: $264.9 million across 498 grants; ranked approximately #35 nationally
Mayo Clinic Hospital–Rochester: 2,059 beds; Methodist Campus (794 beds, 41 ORs) + Saint Marys Campus (1,265 beds, 55 ORs)
Rochester campus: approximately 14 million square feet
US News 2024-25: ranked #1 in diabetes and endocrinology, gastroenterology and GI surgery, and pulmonology and lung surgery
All three destination campuses on US News Best Hospitals Honor Roll
All three destination campuses hold Magnet nursing designation from the American Nurses Credentialing Center
Nobel Prize 1950: Mayo physicians Edward C. Kendall and Philip S. Hench won Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for discovery of cortisone
March 22, 1955: Dr. John W. Kirklin performed the world's first successful open-heart surgery series using the Mayo-Gibbon heart-lung machine
First living kidney donor transplant at Rochester in 1963; 20,000th transplant performed at Mayo Clinic Rochester in February 2020
Medical school name: Mayo Clinic Alix School of Medicine (renamed after $200M gift from Jay Alix announced 2019)
Class size: approximately 105 students per class — Rochester (56) and Scottsdale/Phoenix (50)
All incoming MD students receive a full-tuition scholarship funded by the Jay Alix endowment; tuition listed at $67,900/year for 2025-26 but covered by scholarship
Acceptance rate approximately 3.4%; median MCAT percentile of matriculants rose from 78th to 97th percentile (2014-2024)
Mayo Clinic Platform_Discover holds de-identified data on 13.6+ million patients, 5.8+ billion medical images, 2.72+ billion lab results
Outpatient visits 2024: 5.4 million; more than 1.04 million outpatient digital appointments
Surgical volume 2025: 161,590 surgical cases (4.2% increase over 2024)
Governed by Board of Trustees (31 members, majority non-physician) and Board of Governors (7-14 members); CEO Dr. Gianrico Farrugia chairs Board of Governors
Students from groups underrepresented in medicine grew from 7% (2014) to 18% (2024) of entering medical school class
Mayo Clinic's research funding exceeded $1 billion in 2022.
Mayo Clinic opened a health clinic in central London in early 2020.
In 2022, Mayo Clinic saw more than 1.3 million different patients from all 50 states and 138 countries.
Mayo Clinic spends over $660 million a year on research.
Mayo Clinic College of Medicine and Science was established in 1915.
Mayo Clinic was formed on January 27, 1864, in Rochester, Minnesota.
Mayo Clinic employs over 76,000 people as of 2022.
Mayo Clinic operates more than 70 hospitals and clinics across Minnesota, Iowa, and Wisconsin.
Mayo Clinic has been ranked number one in U.S. News & World Report's Best Hospitals Honor Roll for eight consecutive years.
Mayo Clinic's surgical volume reached 161,590 surgical cases in 2025.
Mayo Clinic's research initiatives led to 9,275 research publications in peer-reviewed journals in 2022.
Mayo Clinic's chairman is Richard K. Davis.
Mayo Clinic Health System was founded in 1992.
Mayo Clinic's research personnel included about 5,500 physicians and scientists in 2022.
Mayo Clinic's class size for the medical school is approximately 105 students per class.
Mayo Clinic's CEO is Gianrico Farrugia, M.D.
Mayo Clinic's acceptance rate is approximately 3.4% for its medical school.
Mayo Clinic Health System served 600,000 patients across its operating regions as of December 2021.
Mayo Clinic Health System's first mobile clinic opened in June 2021.
By February 2022, the mobile clinic had seen 1,000 people.
The mobile clinic used a 39-foot commercial vehicle with two exam rooms.
As of 2022, Mayo Clinic Health System includes 16 hospitals and 53 multispecialty clinics.
Prathibha Varkey has been the president of Mayo Clinic Health System since August 2021.
Mayo Clinic Health System received a $9.4 million grant in 2022 under the American Rescue Plan Act.
Mayo Clinic Health System announced an $11 million diagnostic imaging and sports medicine center in March 2022.
Mayo Clinic's operating revenue was $16.3 billion in 2022.
Mayo Clinic Health System's Eau Claire hospital was ranked number 6 in Wisconsin in 2020.
In 2021, telehealth appointments at Mayo Clinic Health System increased from 4% to 85% of all appointments.
Mayo Clinic Health System's hospitals in Eau Claire, La Crosse, and Mankato were ranked in the top 25 complex care medical centers in 2021.
Mayo Clinic Health System's Albert Lea-Austin hospital was included in Newsweek's list of top U.S. hospitals in 2021.
In 2021, the Leapfrog Group gave hospitals in Red Wing, Eau Claire, and La Crosse an 'A' grade.
Mayo Clinic Health System's facilities include one mobile health clinic.
Mayo Clinic Health System's first groups to join were the Decorah Clinic and Midelfort Clinic in 1992.
Mayo Clinic Health System's Albert Lea hospital underwent $15 million worth of renovations in April 2022.
In 2012, Mayo Clinic Health System reported seeing 500,000 patients annually.
Mayo Clinic Health System's Austin facility completed construction on new medical and surgical inpatient units in June 2021.
Mayo Clinic Health System's Mankato Hospital expansion includes 121 beds and additional surgical units.
Mayo Clinic Health System changed its name from Mayo Health System in 2011.
